title: Geometric algebraically closed comparison square for separably closed fields
statement: Let k and k' be separably closed fields [def-pc-separably-closed], let f : C -> Spec k be a proper curve (separated, finite type, and topological Krull dimension at most one, with the empty scheme allowed) [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let C' -> C be a cartesian square over a morphism Spec k' -> Spec k [def-pc-base-change]. There exist algebraically closed fields K and K' [def-weil-algebraic-closure], schemes D and D', a proper curve b : D -> Spec K, a morphism b' : D' -> Spec K', a morphism j : Spec K' -> Spec K, and morphisms a : D' -> D, p : D -> C, p' : D' -> C', such that the square (a,b',b,j) is cartesian, p and p' are universal homeomorphisms [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], and p' followed by C' -> C equals a followed by p. No sheaf, degree, or cohomological invariance hypothesis is assumed.

theorem sepClosed_geometric_comparison
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    {C C' : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsProper f]
    {ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {f' : C' ⟶ Spec (.of k')} {ι' : C' ⟶ C}
    (h : IsPullback ι' f' f ι) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : IsAlgClosed K)
      (K' : Type u) (_ : Field K') (_ : IsAlgClosed K')
      (D D' : Scheme.{u}) (b : D ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (b' : D' ⟶ Spec (.of K'))
      (j : Spec (.of K') ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (a : D' ⟶ D) (p : D ⟶ C) (p' : D' ⟶ C'),
      IsCurve b ∧ IsProper b ∧ IsPullback a b' b j ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism p ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism p' ∧ p' ≫ ι' = a ≫ p
